newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 651 kg germanium at $1,203/kg.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 651 kg germanium at $1,203/kg.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 651 kg of germanium to four companies at an average price of $1,203 a kg.
Lattice Materials Corp bought a 17-kg lot at $1,265 a kg and another 17-kg lot at $1,190 a kg.
Eagle Pitcher bought a 500-kg lot at $1,202 a kg.
Mistral Inc bought a 100-kg lot at $1,202 a kg.
Tennelec/Nucleus Inc bought a 17-kg lot at $1,200 a kg.
The spot price, Rotterdam, was $1190/$1290 Thursday.
The next bid opening is Aug 25.
